description.value: Your giant dragonfly soars, potentially carrying off a foe with it. Until the start of your next turn, when you hit and deal damage to a creature within your giant dragonfly's reach, the giant dragonfly can Fly as a free action. If your giant dragonfly has a creature @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.kWc1fhmv9LBiTuei]{Grabbed} or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.VcDeM8A5oI6VqhbM]{Restrained}, it can carry the creature with it, treating all spaces as difficult terrain.
